an6.98:1.1: so vata bhikkhave bhikkhu kañci saṃkhāraṃ niccato samanupassanto anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato bhavissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an6.98:1.2: anulomikāya khantiyā asamannāgato sammattaniyāmaṃ okkamissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati
an6.98:1.3: sammattaniyāmaṃ anokkamamāno sotāpattiphalaṃ vā sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vā anāgāmiphalaṃ vā arahattaṃ vā sacchikarissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an6.98:2.1: so vata bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbasaṃkhāre aniccato samanupassanto anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato bhavissatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati
an6.98:2.2: anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato sammattaniyāmaṃ okkamissatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati
an6.98:2.3: sammattaniyāmaṃ okkamamāno sotāpattiphalaṃ vā sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vā anāgāmiphalaṃ vā arahattaṃ vā sacchikarissatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjatīti. 99
